description: Current lines by reported pick count, or with sort=change by the rise since a sample one to two windows back (change_since names it). The count is source-reported with an unverified definition: a popularity signal, not money or a pick recommendation. Most lines report no count. For screens and alerts.

league.description: Optional league code, for example NBA.

sort.description: count: highest count first. change: biggest rise over window_minutes first, measured against a sample one to two windows back; lines with no sample in that range come last.

user_request.description: Optional, and asked for on every data call: the current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words, including follow-ups and pagination. A call without it returns the same data. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

window_minutes.description: How far back change is measured.

name: get_trending
